title: Absence phrases
description: Phrases that name a prop without putting it in the frame, and trace nouns a part can leave behind. A trace does not name the prop and does not stop that prop carrying from the previous shot. The storyboard review, the frame classifier, and the continuity check read this file. A film may replace phrases, ambiguous, or closed_clause in props/absence-phrases.json. A film extends trace_nouns. An empty trace list adds nothing.
